  name                      = var.name
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.arn
}

}

  }
}

-- head/examples/simple/main.tf --
module "this" {
  source = "../.."
  name   = "simple"
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = var.name
  fifo_queue                = var.fifo
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}
-- head/outputs.tf --
output "arn" {
  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.arn
}
-- head/variables.tf --

  type = string
}

variable "fifo" {
  type    = bool
  default = false
}
